findings.title_text: Journals settling one party through another, with no bank or cash line: listed for the CA (may bear on clauses 31 and 21(d))
limits_text: Listed, never judged: the candidate total is a candidate total, not a reportable amount, and nothing is left out for being small or looking harmless. Whether a row is a payment under s.40A(3), a Rule 6DD case, a loan or deposit, a trade set-off, or one person under two ledgers is the CA's to determine; no clause 31 or 21(d) row is written.
Recall is not measured on real books.
Same-person set-offs, rectifications of a wrong-party posting, opening or migration entries, branch ledgers of one entity, and discount or note journals against one party are listed too.
ask_client_text: Journal settling one party through another: whose liability, and who received the value? Is it a loan or deposit taken or repaid by journal (clause 31, codes I/J), a same-person set-off, or a correction?

findings.title_text: Bank or cash entries whose narration names a party other than the one booked: listed for the CA (may bear on clause 21(d) and s.68)
limits_text: Listed, never judged: the candidate total is a candidate total, not a reportable amount, and nothing is left out for being small or looking harmless. Whether a row is a payment under s.40A(3), a Rule 6DD case, a loan or deposit, a trade set-off, or one person under two ledgers is the CA's to determine; no clause 31 or 21(d) row is written.
Recall is not measured on real books.

A name is matched only whole and in full, and only when no other master shares it: a name cut short, broken up, abbreviated, or written in Hindi or Hinglish is missed, and a short or common name may be a coincidence (the proprietor, a family member, the operator).
ask_client_text: The narration names someone other than the booked party. Who was paid (or who paid)? If an agent paid on the payee's behalf, give the agency basis.
